items.exampleEn: Her long red hair distinguishes her from her sisters.
items.exampleZh: 她的一頭紅色長髮讓她和姊妹們有所區別。

items.exampleEn: Nothing could persuade him to change his mind.
items.exampleZh: 沒有什麼能說服他改變心意。

items.exampleEn: The hotel received many inquiries about the price.
items.exampleZh: 飯店接到許多關於價格的詢問。

items.exampleEn: She remarked that the room was very cold.
Try to use logic to solve the puzzle.
items.exampleZh: 試著用邏輯解開這道謎題。

items.exampleEn: Uncertainty about the future is normal at your age.
items.exampleZh: 在你這個年紀，對未來感到不確定是很正常的。

items.exampleEn: After a long talk, we reached a compromise.
items.exampleZh: 談了很久之後，我們達成了妥協。

items.exampleEn: The man's strange behavior raised suspicion.
items.exampleZh: 那名男子奇怪的舉動引起了懷疑。

items.sentenceEn: Don't let anyone persuade you to give up.
items.sentenceZh: 別讓任何人說服你放棄。

items.audioEn: Sorry, I can't distinguish between the salt and the sugar in these jars.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我分不出這些罐子裡哪個是鹽、哪個是糖。
options: Which jar has salt and which has sugar

items.sentenceEn: Good logic is important in math.
items.sentenceZh: 好的邏輯在數學裡很重要。

items.sentenceEn: "The town has changed a lot," he remarked.

items.stemEn: Both sides gave up something; it was a fair ____.
items.stemZh: 雙方都各讓了一步，這是一個公平的折衷。

items.stemEn: Her ____ grew when she saw that the door was open.
items.stemZh: 她看到門開著，心中的懷疑更深了。

items.passageEn: Someone ate the cake that my mom made for my sister's birthday. My little brother was under suspicion because he had chocolate on his face. My mom started an inquiry: she asked everyone where they were that afternoon. My brother said he had eaten a cookie, but his story didn't make sense, because there were no cookies at home. Mom remarked that the dog was also near the kitchen. There was a lot of uncertainty, but it was apparent that my brother was nervous. Finally, he told the truth. To persuade Mom not to punish him, he offered a compromise: he would wash the dishes for a week. Mom agreed. Now she can easily tell when he is lying: he always touches his nose.
items.passageZh: 有人吃了媽媽為我的姊妹生日做的蛋糕。我弟弟有嫌疑，因為他臉上沾著巧克力。媽媽開始調查：她問每個人那天下午在哪裡。弟弟說他吃的是餅乾，但他的說法不合邏輯，因為家裡根本沒有餅乾。媽媽說狗當時也在廚房附近。事情充滿不確定，但很明顯弟弟很緊張。最後，他說出了實話。為了說服媽媽不要處罰他，他提出了一個折衷辦法：他願意洗一個星期的碗。媽媽同意了。現在，媽媽很容易就能分辨他是不是在說謊：他一說謊就會摸鼻子。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼弟弟的說法不合邏輯？
options: 因為家裡根本沒有餅乾

questions.questionZh: 弟弟提出什麼折衷辦法？
options: 幫姊妹重新做一個蛋糕
